name: Smart 404 Redirect Manager
author: Aman Brar

sections.description:
Smart 404 Redirect Manager helps you easily handle all 404 (Not Found) pages by redirecting them to your homepage or any custom URL.
Prevent SEO loss and improve user experience. Lightweight, fast, and compatible with all major plugins.

Features

  • Redirect all 404 errors to homepage or custom URL.
  • Choose between 301 (Permanent) and 302 (Temporary) redirects.
  • Exclude certain URLs from redirection.
  • SEO-friendly and works with all themes.
  • No database load — simple and clean code.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the smart-404-redirect-manager folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → Smart 404 Redirect to configure options.
sections.faq:
Can I redirect to a different page instead of homepage?

Yes, you can set any custom URL in the plugin settings.

Can I exclude certain pages?

Yes, you can add page slugs or paths (comma-separated) under “Excluded URLs.”

short_description: Automatically redirect all 404 errors to the homepage or a custom URL, with options to exclude certain URLs and choose redirect type.
